Its vile inhabitants, the [[blood troll]]s, have pledged their savage hearts and frenzied minds to the Blood God [[G'huun]]. They must destroy the last functioning [[titan]] disc, a relic that lies at the very heart of [[Zuldazar]], to free their master from eons of confinement within the titan facility of [[Uldir]].[[:File:Blizzard Museum - Zandalar.jpg]] ==History== Once the shining heart of [[troll]] civilization,[[Ancient Nazmani Tablet]] Nazmir is now a bleak swamp riddled with ruined reminders of its former greatness. The first king, [[Dazar]], led the trolls out of the muck and mire, fleeing south because of the Old God [[G'huun]], where they built [[Zuldazar]].[[Cracked Tablet]][[King Dazar#Adventure Guide]] Centuries ago,[[Shinga Deathwalker#Quotes]] Nazmir used to be a place of worship for the loa of death [[Bwonsamdi]] which had several temples, at the [[Necropolis (Nazmir)|Necropolis]] and the [[Terrace of Sorrows]]. Many Zandalari trolls used to be there, until [[Vision of a Heretical Nazmani|heretics]] started to appear among them, corrupting, killing or defiling the old worshippers of the loa,[[Kel'vax's Home]] visions later joining [[blood troll]] society. In the current troll capital of [[Zuldazar]], stories are passed down from generation to generation cautioning children to behave, lest these twisted practitioners of [[blood magic]] come to snatch them from their beds. And those who dare brave the swamp have a terrible habit of disappearing, never to return. The blood trolls of Nazmir are the monsters that haunt every Zandalari child's nightmares — and for good reason,[https://worldofwarcraft.com/en-us/news/21797338 Battle for Azeroth Preview: Nazmir Visitor's Guide] as they are dedicated to the worship of the Blood God G'huun and to a single-minded purpose: the destruction of the last functioning titan disc within the city of Zuldazar. Should the trolls shatter this seal, G'huun will be freed from its eons-long confinement to rule the world. Upon arriving in Nazmir, you will meet Princess Talanji, who will ask you to escort her as you look for signs of blood troll activity in the area.[https://us.battle.net/forums/en/wow/topic/20761726635?page=1#1 Alpha Development Notes] It harbors ancient [[titan]] secrets in a [[Uldir|top security facility]] to study the [[Old God]]s, as well as a tool to destroy all life on the [[Azeroth|planet]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Dazar'alor]], the [[Alliance]] covered Nazmir in a thick fog using the [[:Abyssal Scepter]] in order to create a diversion for their army. After Bwonsamdi brought the defeated [[Mueh'zala]] to the Necropolis, [[Zel'han the Summoner]], servant of the defeated loa, was drawing the undead of Nazmir to the Necropolis.[[The Problem with Containing a Death Loa]] ==Getting there== Nazmir can be entered through the [[Brine Basin]], [[Prisoners' Pass]], and the [[Blistering Wastes]] in eastern [[Vol'dun]] and by crossing the bridges over the [[Shattered River]] and going through the [[Blood Gate]] past northern [[Zuldazar]]. ==Geography== Nazmir is a primordial swampland, replete with a diverse ecology of insects and dangerous beasts. Many of the once grand temples and buildings now lay in ruins, scattered throughout the region like broken teeth. Vegetation has encroached upon the stone walls and buildings, reclaiming the land piece by piece. Sodden marshes and tributaries mark the landscape of Nazmir, fed by the grand waterfalls spilling from the cliffs of [[Zuldazar]] high above. The [[Razorjaw River]] and [[Shattered River]] both wind through Nazmir as well, contributing to the marshes and wetlands that dominate the region. A vast coastline surrounds Nazmir to the north and east, with the Shattered River demarking the southern border along Zuldazar. To the west you'll find the bubbling [[Shoaljai Tar Pits]], where the cloying scent of smoke drifts up from vents within the earth, choking the air with a haze of ash and dust. Just west of the tar pits on the westernmost border, the pathway into the arid desert of [[Vol'dun]] awaits. ===Maps and subregions=== [[File:VZ-Nazmir.jpg|thumb|left|Map of Nazmir.]] {| class="darktable hlist" |- | *[[Abandoned Ruin]] *[[Antul'Mita Plateau]] *[[Blood Bog]] *[[Blood Coast]] *[[Bloodfire Ravine]] *[[Burial Mound]] *[[Collapsed Tunnel]] *[[Dreadmire|The Dreadmire]] **[[Necropolis (Nazmir)|The Necropolis]] ***[[Court of Spirits]] ***[[Edge of Oblivion|The Edge of Oblivion]] ***[[Necropolis Catacombs]] **[[Zo'bal Ruins]] ***[[Wayshrine of the Fallen]] *[[Fallen Outpost|The Fallen Outpost]] *[[Fangtooth Bog]] *[[Far Reach|The Far Reach]] *[[Fort Victory]] *[[Frogmarsh|The Frogmarsh]] **[[Krag'wa's Burrow]] **[[Krag'wa's Shore]] **[[Upper Frogmarsh]] *[[Gloomwater Span]] **[[Redfield's Watch]] *[[Grimwatt's Crash]] *[[Kazai]] *[[Lair of Xak'lar]] *[[Mangrove Shore]] **[[Torga's Tavern]] *[[Natha'vor]] *[[Nazwatha]] **[[Gloom Hollow]] **[[Naz'agal]] **[[Seal of Nazmir]] **[[Sundered Span|The Sundered Span]] ***[[Forlorn Ruins]] **[[Wayward Shoals]] *[[Plains of Tojek]] *[[Primal Wetlands]] **[[Urok's Lair]] *[[Razorjaw River]] *[[Rivermarsh|The Rivermarsh]] **[[Zul'jan Ruins]] *[[Sethrak Front]] *[[Shattered River|The Shattered River]] *[[Shoaljai Tar Pits]] *[[Shrine of Bones]] *[[South Seas]] *[[Sunken Coast]] *[[Sunken Path]] *[[Takulu Bridge]] *[[Terrace of Sorrows]] **[[Kel'vax's Shrine]] *[[Torga's Rest]] **[[Torga's Innards]] *[[Xal'vor]] *[[Zal'amak]] *[[Zalamar]] **[[Hir'eek's Lair]] ***[[Fall (Nazmir)|The Fall]] ***[[Sanctum of Midnight]] *[[Zul'Nazman]] **[[Altar of Rot]] **[[Heart of Darkness (Nazmir)|The Heart of Darkness]] **[[Koramar (Nazmir)|Koramar]] **[[Tul'vor]] **[[Uldir]] |- | ---- ;[[Undisplayed location]]s *[[Atul'nazman]] |} {{clear|left}} ===Instances=== [[File:Nazmir 5.jpg|thumb|Nazmir.]] {| class="darktable zebra" !Instance name !Level range !Group size !Approximate run time |- |{{portal|Underrot|bfa}} || 110 -
